name: Gobkit free CC0 3D packs (305 rigged low-poly GLBs)
summary: 305 free CC0 game-ready 3D models from Gobkit: 264 rigged, animated low-poly characters (animals, dinosaurs, birds, insects, professions, orcs, knights) with named idle/attack/dead/walk clips, plus 41 static nature props. All glTF 2.0 .glb, downloadable per pack as zip, no account, no attribution; a public JSON index (/api/free) lists every file. New packs are added regularly.

access.price: $0 (Gobkit's AI monster generator is a separate paid product)
access.notes: CC0 stated on the freebies page and in /api/free for every model. Bundle files into your project; hotlinking only for prototypes.

procedure: Click Download pack on any pack (one zip of .glb files), or fetch individual URLs from https://gobkit.com/api/free.
Import the .glb into Blender, Unity, Godot, Unreal or three.js; play animation clips by name (idle, attack, dead, walk).
Use SkeletonUtils.clone (three.js) to spawn several copies of a rigged model.

verdict.why: Large, genuinely CC0 library of rigged, animated low-poly GLBs with no account, per-pack zips and a machine-readable index, handy for prototypes and jams. Small account and low-poly style; it's the publisher's lead magnet for a paid generator.
